summary: Kimi K3.1 Pro is a large language model released on Hugging Face that can be run locally via the Transformers Python API or a CLI. It provides full model weights and an API/SDK for integration, targeting users who want on‑premise inference without an external API key. Researchers and hobbyists with modest GPU resources will find it useful for experimenting with a 1.0‑version model.
